reason: I already check Internshala, Unstop, LinkedIn, and my placement cell, so I don't see a reason to add another place to search. Free is nice, but setting up hosting and provider credentials sounds like extra hassle while I'm applying.
objection: Will it actually surface good openings I haven't already seen, or just make me maintain one more tracker?
would_change_my_mind: A quick demo showing relevant India campus roles from sources I already use, with no hosting setup on my side.
